description:
Add a clinical progress note to patient Elena Vasquez's active visit. 

1. Find patient **Elena Vasquez** in the patient list.
2. Open her current active visit (Admission for Community-acquired pneumonia).
3. Add a new note to the visit with the following content:
   "Day 3 progress note. Patient reports improved breathing and reduced cough frequency. Temperature 37.2C, respiratory rate 18, SpO2 96% on room air. Lung auscultation reveals clearing bilateral breath sounds with diminished crackles in right lower lobe. Continue current antibiotic regimen of azithromycin 500mg daily. Plan for discharge evaluation tomorrow if clinical improvement continues. Patient educated on importance of completing full antibiotic course."
4. Save the note.
